title: 🛒 Anchorage retail & customer service - several roles hiring now - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Anchorage retail is busy right now – from phones and fashion to fuel stops and fine jewelry, there’s a nice mix of entry-level and management roles open across town.
Here are some of the most interesting customer-facing jobs hiring in Anchorage, AK this week:
Eagle River Safeway – Relationship Specialist 1 (Full Time, Onsite) Employer: Nuvision Federal Credit Union Location: Anchorage, AK (Eagle River Safeway branch) Salary: $22.00–$32.08/hr (AK range) Type: Full Time, Onsite Bank-style role handling cash, opening accounts, card services, and cross‑selling loans and investments. Comes with medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, PTO, tuition reimbursement and a sign‑on bonus for eligible external hires . Pet Groomer & Salon Trainer (Salon Experience Lead) Employer: PetSmart Location: Anchorage, AK Salary: Not listed (groom pay or base pay, whichever is higher; never below local minimum wage) Type: Full Time Lead the grooming salon, train bathers and new stylists, and groom pets yourself. Weekly pay, health benefits, 401(k) with match, PTO, discounts, tuition assistance and lots of hands‑on time with pets. Assistant Manager (2 Anchorage Locations) Employer: Circle K Locations: Store 2746601 – 1405 South Bragaw, Anchorage, AK 99508 Store 2746610 – 1500 East 5th Avenue, Anchorage, AK 99501 Salary: Not listed Type: Listed as Full Time (job card shows Internship type) Help run a busy convenience store: hiring and leading staff, bookkeeping, merchandising and food program. Weekly pay, medical/dental/vision, 401(k) with match, bonuses, PTO, tuition reimbursement and clear growth into higher management. Team Member / Customer Service Representative – Muldoon Rd Employer: Circle K Location: Store 2746631 – 285 Muldoon Road, Anchorage, AK 99504 Salary: Not listed Type: Part Time Flexible shifts (days, evenings, overnights + weekends). Cashiering, light food program work, cleaning and customer help. Weekly pay, bonus potential, benefits eligibility, 401(k) match, tuition reimbursement . Team Member / Customer Service Representative – C Street Employer: Circle K Location: Store 2746638 – 3500 C Street, Anchorage, AK 99503 Salary: Not listed Type: Part Time Evening and overnight shifts. Front‑counter role with register, stocking, and store upkeep. Same benefits, weekly pay, bonuses, and growth path as other Circle K stores. Team Member / Customer Service Representative – Abbott Rd Employer: Circle K Location: Store 2746606 – 1501 Abbott Road, Anchorage, AK 99507 Salary: Not listed Type: Part Time (overnights) Overnight convenience store role with a mix of customer service and store maintenance. Medical, dental, vision options, 401(k) match, tuition reimbursement , and weekly pay. Clinique Freelancer – Beauty Advisor Employer: The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. (via Randstad Sourceright) Location: Anchorage, AK retail locations Salary: $21.60–$32.40/hr Type: Full Time, Freelance assignment In‑store beauty role doing personalized consultations, events and visual merchandising for Clinique and sister brands. Offers competitive pay and access to benefits through the employer of record (Randstad). Store Manager – Holiday Stationstores Employer: Holiday Stationstores (Circle K brand) Location: 10630 Old Seward Hwy., Anchorage, AK 99515 Salary: Starting at $70,000/year Type: Full Time Lead the whole site: hiring, scheduling, merchandising, safety, and full P&L responsibility. Great fit if you have retail leadership experience and want a solid management salary plus benefits in convenience retail. Retail Sales Consultant Employer: AT&T Location: 1118 N Muldoon Rd, Anchorage, AK Salary: $16.94–$20.83/hr + uncapped commission (range assumes sales goals met) Type: Full Time (40 hrs/week) Sell wireless plans, devices and internet using a consultative approach, with community events and online orders mixed in. Strong commission upside plus medical, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, parental leave and big employee discounts on AT&T services. Assistant Manager, Merchandising – Dimond S/C Employer: Gap Location: Dimond Center, Anchorage, AK Salary: Not listed Type: Full Time Mid‑level fashion retail leader overseeing merchandising, operations and team development. Enjoy brand discounts (Gap, Old Navy, Banana Republic, Athleta) , strong PTO, 401(k) with match and volunteer time benefits. Retail Supervisor, Full Time – Dimond S/C Employer: Gap Location: Dimond Center, Anchorage, AK Salary: Not listed Type: Full Time Lead daily tasks and selling behaviors on the floor, support opening/closing and omni‑channel pick‑ups. Same generous merchandise discount, PTO and benefits as other Gap roles. Firearms Sales Outfitter – Part Time Employer: Bass Pro Shops Location: Anchorage, AK Salary: Not listed Type: Part Time Work behind the gun counter helping customers choose firearms and hunting gear, while ensuring ATF paperwork is done correctly. Part‑time staff get store discounts, dental/vision options, 401(k), paid holidays and vacation . Gift Sales Outfitter – Part Time Employer: Bass Pro Shops Location: Anchorage, AK Salary: Not listed Type: Part Time Front‑of‑store role selling gifts and outdoor‑themed merch, restocking, and keeping displays sharp. Includes retail discounts, part‑time benefits, paid holidays and vacation . APPAREL Clerk Employer: Fred Meyer Location: Anchorage, AK Salary: Not listed Type: Part Time Support the apparel department with stocking, tagging, inventory and customer help. Good fit if you like fashion but want big‑box stability and a clear path to more hours. PRODUCE Clerk Employer: Fred Meyer Location: Anchorage, AK Salary: Not listed Type: Part Time Work in fresh produce: stocking, prepping trays, checking quality and helping customers with selection. Food‑handler card required after hire. FLORAL Clerk Employer: Fred Meyer Location: Anchorage, AK Salary: Not listed Type: Full Time Help design arrangements, maintain plants, fill balloon and floral orders, and ring up customers. Nice mix of creative work and classic customer service in a busy grocery setting. Jewelry Sales Specialist Employer: Fred Meyer Jewelers Location: Anchorage, AK Salary: Not listed Type: Full Time Fine‑jewelry sales role focused on special occasions: learn diamonds and gemstones, hit sales targets, and help with repairs and cleanings. Training provided; prior jewelry or retail sales is a plus. Part Sales Manager – Part Time Employer: AutoZone Location: Anchorage, AK Salary: Not listed Type: Part Time (management) Lead part of the store: coach staff, watch sales metrics, oversee inventory and safety, and support commercial accounts. Good stepping stone into full store management.
